tagline.en_US: Official image with managed persistent configuration and selectable content storage. Validated on amd64: clean install, authenticated login, same-digest recreation and interrupted-candidate recovery. Cross-release migration and arm64 runtime not tested.

description.en_US: FileBrowser Quantum is a self-hosted web-based file manager. It provides an interface to access, upload, preview, and edit files across multiple storage sources. The application features user and permission management, real-time search, and customizable file sharing options.
